title: CI follow-up: the code-tree stamp counts .agents/ outside tasks/ as code
goal: scripts/ci-code-proven.sh treats all of .agents/ as inert, while ci-changed-crates.sh counts .agents/ outside tasks/ as ALL: build.rs and root tests (architecture_tests, gmcp_requirements) read identity, roadmap and evidence.json. A push to main that changes only .agents/roadmap.json is stamped proven and skips every test job, so a test it breaks stays hidden until a later merge runs root-cli and is blamed for it. Exclude only .agents/tasks, as ci-changed-crates.sh does; test a roadmap-only head (not proven) and a tasks-only head (proven); correct the stamp and scope comments in test.yml.
